items.author: Anna
items.body: Before we validate an order we have to check the customer's credit limit.

reference:
start > credit_check[service Check credit limit] > validate
@1 credit_check

items.author: Ben
items.body: What if legal takes more than 5 days? Then the department head has to escalate it.

reference:
legal_late[boundary:timer 5 days passed | on=legal_review nonint] > escalate[user Escalate to department head] > escalated[end Escalation raised]
@1 legal_late escalate

items.author: Carla
items.body: We stopped sending these notifications, please remove this step.

items.author: Eve
items.body: This is not a business rule, the recruiter picks the platforms by hand.

items.author: Anna
items.body: There is a third outcome: orders over the credit limit go to a clerk, who reviews them before they are processed.

replies.author: Ben
replies.body: The limit is in the variable creditLimit, the order total in total.

reference:
valid >(Over limit: total > creditLimit) review_order[user Review order] > process
@1 review_order

items.author: Frank
items.body: At the very end the requester should get the result by email.

reference:
finalize > email_result[send Email result to requester] > end
@1 email_result
